text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To be left eating their dust... How 
pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still... if that's the case, there's only 
one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hone myself and clear my name— that is 
all.
